chunks: When the sentence will have been passed against them, We shall bring forth beastly brutes from the earth who will torment them, for men certainly do not believe Our signs.

key_terms.الْقَوْلُ: The divine decree or sentence passed against a group

ai.seo_question: What is the Dabbat al-Ardh (Beast of the Earth) mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse identifies the 'Dabbat al-Ardh' (Beast of the Earth) as a major eschatological sign that will emerge to distinguish between true believers and disbelievers by marking their foreheads. The creature's speech serves as a divine confirmation of the truth, directly addressing the human failure to recognize God's signs (Ayat) during their lifetime. This event underscores the transition from the unseen to the seen, validating the prophetic message for those who previously doubted.
